title: A bike city tour with karlos
text: Karlosis a gem: we’ve had the most wonderful tour under his lead. He’s polite, knowledgeable, helpful, and he is passionate about telling us about his beloved city Seville. He gave us a 5 stars tour and we couldn’t get enough off it! Thank you karlos.
author: kenzabennis00

title: The kids called the bike tour the most fun activity in Seville!
text: Our family have a fun city bike tour experience with our guide Nacho.  He is knowledgeable with the history of the city, took us to the not so tourist spots and told us the stories that we wouldn’t have known.  The kids are so intrigued by his humor and personality!
author: Eric C

title: Super Bike Tour of Seville with Christina
text:
